SDL2: https://www.libsdl.org/download-2.0.php
Download the source code and unzip it in "./dependencies/android/SDL/".

GLEW: http://glew.sourceforge.net/
Download the binaries and unzip them in "./dependencies/android/glew/".

libogg: https://xiph.org/downloads/ (libogg)
Download libogg and unzip it in "./dependencies/android/libogg/".

libvorbis: https://xiph.org/downloads/ (libvorbis)
Download libvorbis and unzip it in "./dependencies/android/libvorbis/".

libtheora: https://xiph.org/downloads/ (libtheora)
Download libtheora and unzip it in "./dependencies/android/libtheora/".
